name: Storm
description: An intense spell of weather bringing strong winds, rain and changing skies.

name: Thunder
description: A deep rumbling sound produced when lightning suddenly heats the air.

name: Fog
description: A cloud of tiny water droplets suspended close to the ground.

name: Mist
description: A thin veil of suspended droplets that softens distant details.

name: Blizzard
description: A severe snowstorm with strong wind and very poor visibility.

name: Tornado
description: A rapidly rotating column of air extending down from a storm cloud.

name: Hurricane
description: A huge tropical cyclone fueled by warm ocean water.

name: Monsoon
description: A seasonal wind shift that brings intense periods of rainfall.

name: Drizzle
description: Fine and gentle rain made from very small falling droplets.

name: Flood
description: Water covering land that is usually dry after heavy rain or overflow.

name: Pressure
description: The force exerted over an area, important to atmospheric changes.

name: Humidity
description: The amount of water vapor present in the surrounding air.

name: Forecast
description: A prediction of future weather from observations and models.

name: Barometer
description: An instrument that measures air pressure to track changing weather.

name: Thermometer
description: A measuring instrument that reveals the temperature of a place.

name: Heatwave
description: An extended spell of unusually hot weather across an area.

name: Ant
description: A social insect that gathers food and works with nest mates.

name: Anthill
description: A mound of soil built around the tunnels of an ant colony.

name: Beetle
description: A hardy insect protected by a pair of firm wing covers.

name: Ladybug
description: A colorful spotted beetle that often feeds on garden aphids.

name: Wasp
description: A narrow-waisted flying insect that may hunt pests or visit flowers.

name: Mosquito
description: A small flying insect whose females can feed on blood.

name: Moth
description: A mostly night-flying relative of the butterfly.

name: Grasshopper
description: A long-legged insect known for jumping across grassy fields.

name: Cricket
description: A chirping insect that makes rhythmic sounds by rubbing its wings.

name: Silk
description: A smooth strong natural fiber spun by certain insects.

name: Bee Bread
description: Fermented pollen stored in honeycomb cells to nourish young bees.

name: Insect Hotel
description: A shelter of hollow stems and timber for beneficial garden insects.

name: Aphid
description: A tiny plant-feeding insect commonly visited by ants and ladybugs.

name: Termite
description: A wood-eating social insect that helps break down dead plants.

name: Swarm
description: A moving cluster of insects traveling or gathering as a group.

name: Praying Mantis
description: A watchful insect that seizes prey with folded front legs.

name: Brick
description: A shaped block of clay hardened by drying or firing.

name: Clay
description: Fine mineral-rich earth that can be shaped when wet.

name: Cement
description: A powdered binder that hardens after reacting with water.

name: Concrete
description: A hard construction mix made from binder, water and aggregates.

name: Arch
description: A curved structure that carries weight across an opening.

name: Column
description: A tall load-bearing support used in buildings and monuments.

name: Tower
description: A tall structure built for defense, observation or communication.

name: Cathedral
description: A grand church built as a center of a bishop’s community.

name: Ruins
description: Remains of buildings that reveal the passage of time.

name: Monument
description: A structure preserving the memory of a person or event.

name: Plaza
description: An open public square where streets and communities meet.

name: Museum
description: A place that preserves and presents objects for learning.

name: Library
description: A building that keeps books and knowledge accessible.

name: Canal
description: A man-made waterway guiding boats or irrigation through land.

name: Aqueduct
description: A structure that carries water across a valley or town.

name: Scaffold
description: A temporary frame that lets builders work above the ground.

name: Harbor
description: A sheltered coastal place where vessels can safely stop.

name: Compass
description: An instrument that points toward magnetic north.

name: Navigation
description: The art and science of finding a route from place to place.

name: Anchor
description: A heavy device that holds a vessel in place against drift.

name: Rudder
description: A steering surface that turns a boat through water.

name: Mast
description: An upright spar that supports a sailing vessel’s sails.

name: Keel
description: The central structural spine running along the bottom of a hull.

name: Sail
description: A sheet of material that catches wind to move a boat.

name: Port
description: A maritime gateway where vessels exchange goods and people.

name: Buoy
description: A floating marker that guides boats or warns of obstacles.

name: Fishing Net
description: A web of cord that catches fish while allowing water through.

name: Lifeboat
description: A small boat kept ready to rescue people in danger.

name: Cargo Ship
description: A large vessel built to carry goods across the sea.

name: Shipyard
description: A waterfront workshop where boats are built and repaired.

name: Sonar
description: A system that uses sound waves to detect objects underwater.

name: Sextant
description: An optical instrument used to measure angles between stars and the horizon.

name: Artifact
description: An object made or used by people, revealing clues about the past.

name: Relic
description: A surviving object valued for its connection to earlier times.

name: Excavation
description: Careful digging to uncover buried structures or objects.

name: Pyramid
description: A monumental structure with broad base and tapering sides.

name: Mummy
description: A body preserved by deliberate treatment or dry conditions.

name: Hieroglyphics
description: Picture-based writing used in ancient Egyptian inscriptions.

name: Explorer
description: A curious traveler who ventures beyond familiar places.

name: Expedition
description: A journey organized to investigate a distant place.

name: Landmark
description: A distinctive feature used to recognize and locate a place.

name: Rock Art
description: Images scratched or painted onto natural stone surfaces.

name: Tomb
description: A place built or prepared for the burial of the dead.

name: Archaeologist
description: A specialist who studies the past through material evidence.

name: Treasure Map
description: A drawn set of directions hinting at a hidden prize.

name: Ancient City
description: A former urban center whose remains tell a story of civilizations.

name: Cave Painting
description: Ancient images preserved on the stone walls of a cave.

name: Sarcophagus
description: A decorated stone coffin used for an important burial.
